answer_text: The lens formulaa is 1/v - 1/u = 1/f, wheree distances to the left of the optical centre are negative. For a concave lens the object distance u is -20 cm. The virtual image lies on the same side, so v is -10 cm. Then 1/f = 1/(-10) - 1/(-20) = -1/10 + 1/20 = -1/20, so f = -20 cm. The negative focal length shows that the lens is diverging, that is, concave.
